description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the "Average performance on November 2024 AMC 10/12 tests" for several models. The horizontal axis contains the categories, displaying specific model names with diagonally rotated labels. The vertical value axis is labeled "Average score (temperature = 0.5)" and uses a linear scale with numerical tick marks from 60 to 90 at intervals of 10, starting from a baseline of 60 rather than zero. The bars are visually categorized by color based on a top-left legend, where light blue signifies a "Large model" and solid blue signifies a "Small model." The bars are sorted in ascending order from left to right according to their scores, with each bar featuring an exact numerical annotation and an error bar at its top. The shortest bar represents the lowest average score of 66.4 for "Llama-3.3 70B Instruct" (light blue). Moving right, the values steadily increase: "Claude 3.5 Sonnet" at 74.8 (light blue), "Qwen 2.5 14b-Instruct" at 77.4 (blue), "GPT 4o" at 77.9 (light blue), "GPT 4o-mini" at 78.2 (blue), "Qwen 2.5 72b-Instruct" at 78.7 (light blue), "Gemini Flash 1.5" at 81.6 (blue), and "Gemini Pro 1.5" at 89.8 (light blue). The tallest bar represents the highest score of 91.8 for "phi-4" (blue). Finally, the "phi-4" label on the horizontal axis is visually emphasized with bold text.
